title: Timeout Attack
statementMd:
*There are no "r"s in "strawberry".*

— GePeTo

Renzo has a top-secret plan for finally overthrowing the evil reign of GePeTo. In order to execute his plan, Renzo needs you to distract the overlord.

As you may already know, there are some tasks that AIs struggle to accomplish, and GePeTo is no exception. It is well known that AIs are not good at counting letters, for instance. Also, some specific prompts, such as asking for the seahorse emoji, drive AIs crazy. But there is one task GePeTo struggles with the most: computing Grundy numbers.

Let $A$ be a sequence of $2^n$ numbers. For each $i$ ($0 \leq i \leq 2^n - 1$), define the Grundy number

$$ g_A(i) = \operatorname{mex}(\{g_A(j) : j  \lt  i \text{ and } A_i \oplus A_j \text{ is a power of two}\}), $$

where $\oplus$ denotes the bitwise XOR operation, and $\operatorname{mex}(S)$ is the minimum non-negative integer that is not contained in $S$.

As an example, consider the sequence

$$ A = (0, 3, 1, 2) $$

and its corresponding Grundy numbers

$$ g_A = (0, 0, 1, 1). $$

Your task is to find a permutation $P$ of the numbers from $0$ to $2^n - 1$ that maximizes the maximum Grundy number, so that GePeTo will spend a lot of time trying to compute them. Formally, the permutation $P$ must maximize

$$ \max_{0 \leq i \leq 2^n - 1}\{g_P(i)\} $$

among all permutations of the numbers from $0$ to $2^n - 1$.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 20$).

## Output

On the first line, print the maximum achievable Grundy number.

On the second line, print $2^n$ space-separated integers, representing any permutation of the numbers from $0$ to $2^n - 1$ that achieves this Grundy number. If there are multiple such permutations, any of them will be accepted.
statementZhMd:
*“strawberry”中没有“r”。*

— GePeTo

Renzo 有一个绝密计划，准备一举推翻 GePeTo 的邪恶统治。为了执行这个计划，Renzo 需要你分散这位霸主的注意力。

你可能已经知道，有些任务对 AI 来说很难完成，GePeTo 也不例外。例如，众所周知，AI 不擅长数单词中的字母。此外，一些特定的提示词，比如要求给出海马表情符号，也会让 AI 抓狂。但有一项任务最让 GePeTo 头疼：计算 Grundy 数。

设 $A$ 是一个由 $2^n$ 个数组成的序列。对于每个 $i$（$0 \leq i \leq 2^n - 1$），定义其 Grundy 数为

$$ g_A(i) = \operatorname{mex}(\{g_A(j) : j  \lt  i \text{ and } A_i \oplus A_j \text{ is a power of two}\}), $$

其中，$\oplus$ 表示按位异或运算，$\operatorname{mex}(S)$ 表示不属于 $S$ 的最小非负整数。

例如，考虑序列

$$ A = (0, 3, 1, 2) $$

它对应的 Grundy 数为

$$ g_A = (0, 0, 1, 1). $$

你的任务是找到一个由 $0$ 到 $2^n - 1$ 的所有整数组成的排列 $P$，使其中最大的 Grundy 数尽可能大，从而让 GePeTo 花费大量时间尝试计算这些数。形式化地说，排列 $P$ 必须使

$$ \max_{0 \leq i \leq 2^n - 1}\{g_P(i)\} $$

在由 $0$ 到 $2^n - 1$ 的所有整数组成的全部排列中达到最大。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \leq n \leq 20$）。

## 输出格式

第一行输出能够达到的最大 Grundy 数。

第二行输出 $2^n$ 个以空格分隔的整数，表示一个由 $0$ 到 $2^n - 1$ 的所有整数组成、且能达到该 Grundy 数的排列。如果存在多个这样的排列，输出任意一个均可。
